rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
scope: the 7 rows without ok; nothing else in the town was re-checked
how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; each row searched with its Chinese name (zh) and/or its English name and the town. Maps' coverage of mainland China is thin: many listings carry no hours at all. A list result's hours line ('Open · Closes 10 PM', or 'Open now', which Maps shows only when it holds the place's hours) counted as a current listing. Where Maps could not settle a row, one web search (snippets only, pages not opened) was made for it.
